$comment: Tunable QA rules. coverage.* is read by scripts/auto-qa-tuner.mjs (.github/workflows/auto-qa.yml); nightly.* is read by .github/workflows/nightly-compliance.yml. Tuning never lowers a floor automatically and never commits: raises are proposed in a tracking issue and applied by a human.

coverage.note: Headroom is measured minus floor, in percentage points of kcov line coverage. When it exceeds raise_floor_when_headroom_exceeds the proposed floor is floor(measured - buffer_below_measured); it is never above that and never below the current floor.

nightly.note: The upstream-contract check fetches manifest_url and verifies the fields openaudible-autoupdate.sh reads (version, download_dir, platforms[platform_key].file and .sha256). It never downloads the rpm. manifest_url and platform_key mirror the defaults of VERSION_URL and PLATFORM_KEY in the script.
